```{r human}
#data from ~/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/scripts/cluster_rna.qmd
snrna.data <- readRDS(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/data/combined_fixed_tumors_raw.rds"))

snrna.data@meta.data["condition"] <- "human_tumor"

Idents(snrna.data) <- "orig.ident"

snrna.data <- SplitObject(snrna.data)

snrna.data <- lapply(snrna.data, function(x) {
  x[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(x, pattern = "^MT-")
  x
  })

human_mito <- lapply(snrna.data, function(x) {
  FeatureScatter(x, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
  }
  )

human_mito <- patchwork::wrap_plots(human_mito)

ggsave("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/plots/QC/mito_nfeature_human.png", human_mito,width = 21, height = 16, units = "in")

snrna.data <- lapply(snrna.data, function(x) {
  Idents(x) <- "orig.idents"
  x
})

human_feat <- patchwork::wrap_plots(lapply(snrna.data, function(x) {
  FeatureScatter(x, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
  }
  ))

ggsave("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/plots/QC/nfeature_human.png", human_feat,width = 21, height = 16, units = "in")

snrna.data <- lapply(snrna.data, function(x) {
  x <- subset(
    x,
    subset = nFeature_RNA > 250 &
             nFeature_RNA < 9000 &
             nCount_RNA < 75000 &
             percent.mt < 15
  )

  x <- NormalizeData(x)
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(x)
  x <- ScaleData(x)
  x <- RunPCA(x)
  x <- FindNeighbors(x, dims = 1:30)
  x <- FindClusters(x, resolution = .8, algorithm = 4, random.seed = 2026)
  x <- RunUMAP(x, dims = 1:30)
  x
})

#Number of cells before filtering
cells_bef_filt <- tribble(
  ~orig.ident,      ~cells_recovered,
  "GSM8058157", 2107, 
  "GSM8058158", 5903, 
  "GSM8058159", 9662, 
  "GSM8058160", 5889, 
  "GSM8058161", 11731, 
  "GSM8058162", 1545, 
  "GSM8058163", 6862, 
  "GSM8058164", 4358, 
  "GSM8058165", 2792)

multi_rate <- tribble(
  ~multi_rate,      ~cells_recovered,
  0.004, 500,
  0.008, 1000,
  0.016, 2000,
  0.023, 3000,
  0.031, 4000,
  0.039, 5000,
  0.046, 6000,
  0.054, 7000,
  0.061, 8000,
  0.069, 9000,
  0.076, 10000)

model.lm <- lm(multi_rate ~ cells_recovered, data = multi_rate)

multi_rate <- predict(model.lm, newdata = cells_bef_filt)

cells_bef_filt <- cbind(cells_bef_filt, multi_rate)

gc()

snrna.data <- lapply(snrna.data, function(x) {
  nExp <- round(cells_bef_filt[cells_bef_filt$orig.ident %in% x$orig.ident,]$multi_rate*length(x$orig.ident))
  x <- doubletFinder(x, PCs = 1:15, pN = 0.25, pK = 0.09, nExp = nExp, reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE)
  x
})

doublet_plots_human <- lapply(names(snrna.data), function(x) DimPlot(snrna.data[[x]], group.by = colnames(snrna.data[[x]]@meta.data)[11]) + ggtitle(x))

doublet_plots_human <- patchwork::wrap_plots(doublet_plots_human, guides = "collect")

ggsave("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/plots/QC/human_plot_doub.png", doublet_plots_human, width = 21, height = 16, units = "in")

clus_plots_human <- lapply(names(snrna.data), function(x) DimPlot(snrna.data[[x]], group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.8", label = TRUE) + ggtitle(x) + NoLegend()) 

clus_plots_human <- patchwork::wrap_plots(clus_plots_human)

ggsave("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/plots/QC/clus_plots_human.png", clus_plots_human, width = 21, height = 16, units = "in")

qs_save(snrna.data, file = "/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/data/processed/preprocessed/human_prep.qs2", nthreads = 6)
```
